title: Add Nectar MCP to image
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Nectar MCP](https://github.com/pinkpixel-dev/nectar-mcp) to image
- Nectar is a stdio MCP server for Pollinations image, video, and audio generation. It gives MCP clients a focused set of creative media tools. Generate and edit images, create videos, and generate spee

Fixes #14437

gist.headline: Nectar joins the garden
gist.blurb: Nectar MCP has landed in the image, bringing a compact creative toolkit for MCP clients. Ask an agent for pixels, video, or speech; the little media greenhouse is now stocked.
gist.summary: Added Nectar MCP, a stdio MCP server that gives compatible clients focused Pollinations tools for generating and editing images, creating videos, and generating speech.
gist.impact: Developers using MCP clients can now access Pollinations image, video, and audio generation through Nectar's dedicated creative-media toolset.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Nectar as a cozy nectar jar or flowering creative-tool station connected to a retro terminal, with separate pixel blossoms representing images, video frames, and sound waves. Polli, wearing tiny maker goggles, helps the eager CRT Monitor Robot route these creative outputs through glowing garden pipes, making the MCP connection feel like a friendly media greenhouse.
